story.title: The Great Onion Chopper Debacle
story.question: Can Barnaby's motorized onion goggles survive a public demonstration at the morning vegetable market?
story.answer: Yes, but only after causing a localized weeping epidemic that permanently changes local soup recipes.

story_beats.headline: The Prototype Reveal
story_beats.speech: Behold the tear-stopper ninety-thousand! It dices bulb onions in milliseconds without a single drop of watery sadness leaking.
story_beats.label: The Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby proudly stands at his wooden market stall, wearing bulky brass goggles with spinning twin blades, pointing to a bewildered elderly melon vendor.

story_beats.headline: Constructing the Rig
story_beats.speech: I must secure the dual-gear piston safely onto my temple before tightening the titanium adjustment screws for stability.
story_beats.label: The Build
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby tightly grips a miniature iron wrench in his right hand, frantically adjusting the side gears of his goggles while standing behind a pyramid of purple onions.

story_beats.headline: Turbo Mechanism Engaged
story_beats.speech: Activating the high-velocity gearbox now will surely demonstrate our unmatched culinary engineering superiority to every skeptical onlooker.
story_beats.label: The Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby aggressively yanks a glowing red lever on his belt pack, causing green warning lights to flash rapidly on his spinning goggle lenses.

story_beats.headline: The Onion Payoff
story_beats.speech: Success at last! Every single onion in the entire marketplace is perfectly sliced and seasoned to absolute perfection.
story_beats.label: The Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands victorious amid a gentle fog of mild onion mist, holding a golden trophy while cheering market shoppers wipe happy tears.

story.central_conflict: Barnaby tests his untested automatic onion-slicing goggles in front of the entire morning market.
story.decisive_choice: Barnaby flips the turbo-speed lever to impress the picky produce guild master.
story.resolution: The goggles shred onions at supersonic speeds, blanketing the square in harmless vapor and winning first prize.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful stop-motion claymation aesthetic with expressive character animations and detailed prop textures.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild orange hair, a green tweed vest, oversized round spectacles, and smudge marks on his cheeks.

locations.Market Square: A bustling cobblestone town square lined with striped canvas awnings, wooden crates, and hanging lanterns.

objects.Goggles: Bulky brass eyewear featuring motorized spinning steel blades, blinking indicator lights, and a leather head strap.
objects.Lever: A polished copper activation switch mounted on a heavy leather belt pack with connected rubber tubing.

story.title: The Midnight Express Misdirection
story.question: Can a stray platform cat expose a stolen pocket watch before the morning train departs?
story.answer: Yes, by leading the stationmaster directly to the clever pickpocket hiding inside the old luggage locker.

story_beats.headline: The Missing Heirloom
story_beats.speech: My grandfather's engraved timepiece is gone from my pocket, stolen right here on the crowded platform during the rush.
story_beats.label: Platform Theft
story_beats.visual_prompt: A distraught passenger in a tweed suit gestures toward the ticking platform clock while the stationmaster listens intently under the flashing departure signal.

story_beats.headline: The Unexpected Guide
story_beats.speech: Look at Barnaby, our stray station cat. He is pawing insistently at the rusted ventilation grate of locker forty-two.
story_beats.label: Feline Clue
story_beats.visual_prompt: The stationmaster kneels beside a fluffy calico cat that swats at the metal door of a numbered luggage locker in the dim concourse.

story_beats.headline: The Lock Mechanism
story_beats.speech: We must use the master key to open this jammed compartment before the suspect boards the southbound express train.
story_beats.label: Locker Entry
story_beats.visual_prompt: The stationmaster inserts a heavy brass key into the stubborn padlock of the luggage locker while the cat watches closely from a nearby wooden bench.

story_beats.headline: The Apprehension
story_beats.speech: Here is the stolen silver watch, tucked safely inside the suspect's travel bag right beside the ticket puncher.
story_beats.label: Stolen Recovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: The stationmaster holds up the gleaming silver pocket watch triumphantly as the guilty traveler is escorted away by railway security toward the boarding gates.

story.central_conflict: A stolen silver pocket watch hidden in a locked station locker
story.decisive_choice: Following the stray calico cat into the dark service corridor
story.resolution: The watch is recovered and returned just as the express whistles

visual_bible.style: Detailed Victorian railway aesthetic with warm amber lighting and rich textures of polished brass and weathered wood.

characters.passenger: An anxious traveler wearing a brown tweed suit, round spectacles, and carrying a leather suitcase.
characters.stationmaster: A stern yet kind railway official in a crisp navy uniform with gold brass buttons and a peaked cap.
characters.cat: Barnaby, a fluffy calico cat with distinct orange and black patches and bright green eyes.

locations.platform: A bustling Victorian railway platform with arched iron girders, steam billowing from locomotives, and wooden benches.
locations.concourse: A dimly lit station concourse lined with rows of numbered iron luggage lockers and fading travel posters.

objects.pocket_watch: An antique engraved silver pocket watch attached to a braided silver chain.
objects.master_key: A large, ornate brass key with a heavy circular handle.
objects.locker_forty_two: A dark green metal locker door with a rusted latch and bold white numbers.

story.title: The Ridge Where the Storm Breaks
story.question: Can the veteran climber reach the stranded avalanche survivor before nightfall?
story.answer: Yes, by trusting his old compass through the whiteout.

story_beats.headline: The Hidden Signal
story_beats.speech: Look closely at the blinking amber light piercing through the heavy swirling snow right across the jagged gorge.
story_beats.label: Beacon in the Mist
story_beats.visual_prompt: A lone rescuer stands on a rocky outcrop holding an emergency radio, looking across a wide chasm at a faint blinking amber light in the distant blizzard.

story_beats.headline: Crossing the Slab
story_beats.speech: We cannot wait for the backup team. Step lightly across this frozen crust before the entire shelf gives way completely.
story_beats.label: The Snow Bridge
story_beats.visual_prompt: The protagonist carefully tiptoes across a narrow, snow-covered rock bridge flanked by pine trees, holding a gripped ice axe tightly in his right hand with intense concentration.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Pivot
story_beats.speech: Turn the emergency winch drum clockwise until the cable locks firmly against the granite anchor to hold our weight.
story_beats.label: Anchor Winch
story_beats.visual_prompt: The protagonist operates a mechanical hand-cranked winch bolted into the frozen cliffside, his face lit by a headlamp while heavy snow falls around him.

story_beats.headline: Safe Haven
story_beats.speech: Grab my insulated jacket and drink this warm tea. We made it off the ridge before the storm locked us in.
story_beats.label: Rescue Shelter
story_beats.visual_prompt: The rescuer and the survivor sit inside a glowing emergency metal shelter cabin, holding steel mugs of hot tea as the heavy metal door stands half-open against the blizzard outside.

story.central_conflict: A sudden blizzard cuts off the descent route for a stranded hiker while daylight fades.
story.decisive_choice: Abandoning the primary marked trail to cross the unstable wind-slab bridge directly.
story.resolution: The rescuer reaches the shelter cave just in time, guiding the survivor down safely.

visual_bible.style: Realistic cinematic mountain documentary aesthetic with cold blue and stark white color palettes, dramatic lighting, and gritty textural details.

characters.protagonist: Liam, a seasoned fifty-year-old mountain rescue leader with weathered skin, wearing a heavy orange parka, black reinforced mountaineering trousers, and a grey wool beanie.

locations.ridge: A steep, windswept alpine ridge featuring exposed granite rock, deep snowdrifts, and scattered frost-bitten pine trees under an overcast grey sky.

objects.ice_axe: A standard steel-headed mountaineering ice axe with a rubber-wrapped blue handle and a woven wrist leash.
objects.emergency_radio: A rugged olive-green two-way radio with a short flexible antenna and a small glowing amber LED screen.
